title: Job Workspace + Cross-Module Navigation Consistency
businessRequirement: Improve job workspace and cross-module navigation consistency without changing the existing booking/job data model or any frozen CR-008 business workflow.
requirements: Add explicit Jobs register / Jobs navigation using the existing single Booking/Job data model.
Reuse the existing /bookings/{ID} Job Workspace as the only job detail workspace.
Add Carrier Payment / Payer Control to the JobContextRail Related Tasks section with Quick View support.
Add Open Job and Quick View actions to the NVOCC Booking Register.

Preserve all CR-008 UI, workflows, data structures, role/privacy boundaries, NVOCC, Global Forwarding, Finance, Payment, Release, Operations Control, Action Queue, SLA Automation, Notification Center, external communications and Control Tower.
nonGoals: No second Job entity or table.
No API schema change unless a verified gap makes one strictly necessary.
No change to booking creation, quote acceptance, finance, payment, release, document or closeout lifecycle.
No change to customer/KYC/carrier privacy rules.

web.impact: Add explicit Jobs navigation item while preserving grouped menu/search behavior.
New presentation-only Jobs Register over existing /bookings API/data. No new job model.
Add Carrier Payment / Payer entry to Related Tasks + Quick View using existing /carrier-payment?bookingId= route.
Add Open Job and Quick View actions per NVOCC booking row, reusing /bookings/{id} and existing embed/Quick View convention.
Reference/source register remains unchanged; optional shared presentation helper reuse only.

api.impact: No planned behavior change. Jobs Register reads existing booking/job data only.
No planned behavior change; only navigation exposure from JobContextRail.
No planned behavior change; NVOCC row actions use existing booking IDs.

rules: Jobs navigation must not broaden data scope beyond existing /bookings authorization.
NVOCC Open Job/Quick View must preserve Agent/Branch/Global Admin NVOCC scope.
Carrier Payment/Payer Quick View must continue enforcing existing internal/Forwarding authorization and customer/KYC privacy.
No external role may gain internal finance, carrier buy-rate, Control Tower, SLA or KYC visibility.

jobsRegister.semantics: Operational Jobs view across NVOCC + Forwarding, not a second source of truth.

tests: Verify /jobs renders the same underlying NVOCC and Forwarding records as /bookings with no duplicated records.
Verify 5-digit jobs 50001–50005 are visible and open /bookings/{id}.
Verify Jobs menu search and grouped sidebar remain stable on desktop/tablet/mobile.
Verify JobContextRail includes Carrier Payment / Payer and its Quick View iframe opens the existing carrier-payment route with bookingId.
Verify Carrier Payment / Payer Quick View preserves existing Forwarding-only behavior and does not expose customer/KYC data.
Verify NVOCC Booking Register Open Job navigates to the existing job workspace.
Verify NVOCC Quick View opens embedded /bookings/{id} without replacing the portal page.
Verify Agent NVOCC scope cannot open out-of-scope jobs.
Verify CUSTOMER/SHIPPER/CONSIGNEE do not gain internal Jobs navigation unless already permitted by the existing frozen role model.
Verify existing Booking Register, Booking Control, NVOCC Portal and Global Forwarding Portal remain unchanged in business behavior.
Verify Finance, Documents, Payment, Release, Operations Control, Action Queue, SLA, Notifications and external communications smoke tests remain PASS.
Verify no database migration and no new API model/table is introduced.
acceptanceCriteria: One canonical Booking/Job data model remains in use.
Jobs is a navigation/register view only.
All Open Job actions resolve to /bookings/{id}.
Carrier Payment/Payer is available in JobContextRail Related Tasks and Quick View.
NVOCC Booking Register exposes Open Job and Quick View without widening NVOCC role scope.
No CR-008 workflow, privacy, finance, payment, release, notification or communication regression.

note: Definition and impact/regression plan only. No implementation, merge, build, test, staging deploy or production action is authorized by this proposal.
